description:
Today the send hook copies the whole message into the receiver's heap, then runs the receiver's matcher with the receiver as the allocating process (runtime/src/aot_shim.rs:512-535, runtime/src/sched.rs:95-122, src/exec/runtime.rs:186, src/ir_interp/backend.rs send path). ParkRecord::try_match (runtime/src/park.rs:73-88) already takes the allocating process and the message as arguments; the receiver's own scan at reach_receive (sched.rs:148) and the probe (sched.rs:98) share the one compiled matcher.

Change: probe_sender runs try_match with the SENDER as the allocating process against the sender's own message. Hit: open a gift (ticket "A heap can open, cut and graft a gift segment"), deep-copy the bound values with one forwarding map into it as the captures of a partial closure that also carries the clause index, end the gift. Miss: open a gift, deep-copy the message into it, end the gift. The gift plus its payload is one in-queue entry on the receiver. On a hit the sender consumes the park record, cancels the after timer as today, and wakes the receiver through the core's one transition. The receiver, when dispatched, drains its in-queue: grafts each segment, pushes a miss onto its mailbox, and materializes the outcome closure from its template and a hit's partial closure (materialize_outcome_closure stays). Self-send never enters this path (prior ticket).

Removals in this ticket: deep_copy_send_ref_for_aot and the JIT/interpreter equivalents that write into a receiver's heap; the receiver-heap copy before the probe; the sentence at .agent/docs/pattern-matching.md:330-332 saying a winning probe copies projected arguments into the receiver heap is rewritten to the new fact.

Telemetry: fz.runtime.send.probe with outcome (hit|miss), reductions charged to the sender, bytes gifted, blocks gifted; emitted on all three paths and carried by the jsonl backend.

Tests (fixtures, all three paths, same output):
- The proposal's worked example: child sends {:log, 50_000-element list} then {:ok, [1,2,3]} to a parent parked on {:ok, xs}. Assert: probe telemetry shows one miss then one hit; the hit's gifted bytes equal three cons cells plus the partial closure; the receiver's heap receives zero bytes from the send path; the receiver is woken exactly once; output is identical on interp, run and build.
- A miss path fixture where the receiver later receives the message from its mailbox.
- Existing receive fixtures 00686-00693 and every receive-bearing fixture stay green.
- A unit test proving a hit's bound values that share structure keep that sharing after the copy (one forwarding map).

Done when the above pass, the full gate is green (fixture_matrix --test-threads=1), no golden/pin is edited (report any that would move), and the interpreter path is verified in this ticket, not deferred. Commit in Why / What changed / Verification form; no co-author trailer.
title: The probe matches on the sender and gifts its result through the receiver's in-queue
